items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Erstausstattung benefits
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 10 Apr 2026 (Jobcenter, social law under SGB X). Deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: Tue 14 Apr 2026 (no weekend shift rule applies to this delivery-fiction day itself). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X): 15 Apr 2026. One month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) ends on Thu 14 May 2026, which is Christi Himmelfahrt, a public holiday in Hessen. Under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next working day: Fri 15 May 2026.

warnings: This Widerspruch deadline (15 May 2026) has already passed as of today (26 Sep 2026); if the person still wants to challenge this decision, they should seek advice immediately on whether a late objection (Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand) or other remedy is still possible.
